channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Writers, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Writers, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Writers fellowship - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Sundance Institute: Episodic Program and Lab 2027
    https://filmfreeway.com/SundanceEpisodicLab2027
    Sundance Institute · deadline Closed 25 Aug 2026 · No stipend or honorarium for participation. For the in-person Lab, Sundance covers round-trip basic economy airfare from the airport nearest the fellow's residence, shared housing with a private room and bath, and ground transport to and from the airport (fellows within 100 miles of the Lab get ground transport only). Meals, in-room charges, travel insurance, luggage fees and taxes are the fellow's own cost. One selected project also receives a separate monetary grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation for a series with an illuminating emphasis on science, including medicine, energy, technology or invention. APPLICATION FEE: USD 50 nonrefundable processing fee per project submitted.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new Writers fellowships - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Kennan Institute Digital Fellowship 2026-2027
    https://www.kennaninstitute.org/digital-fellowship
    Kennan Institute, Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars (supported by the Lounsbery Foundation and the U.S. Russia Foundation) · deadline Closed 14 Aug 2026 · USD 2,000 monthly stipend for the six-month programme, plus mentorship from the Kennan community of experts, six virtual webinars tailored to the cohort, and inclusion in the Kennan alumni network of over 4,500 people. Travel and visa costs are explicitly not covered. No application fee.
  • Good Life Residents Program: AI and Finance
    https://rooseveltinstitute.org/careers/good-life-resident-program/
    Roosevelt Institute, in partnership with Data & Society · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,000 stipend, plus travel and accommodation for the culminating event if needed. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Writers fellowship - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Pulitzer Center: AI Accountability Fellowships 2026-2027
    https://pulitzercenter.org/grants-fellowships/opportunities-journalists/ai-accountability-fellowships
    Pulitzer Center · deadline Closed 12 Jul 2026 · Up to USD 25,000 per fellow, paid in three installments (up to USD 20,000 for reporting and USD 5,000 for engagement activities); covers records requests, travel, data analysis and engagement costs. Freelancers may budget up to one third of the total as a stipend; newsrooms are expected to pay staff salaries. No application fee.
